$comment: Manifest entries for `figma`, read by src/lib/manifest-parts.ts. The CLI never calls Figma: each action writes files and prints the Figma MCP tool calls to make, in order.

commands.name: figma tokens
commands.summary: The brand tokens as Figma variables (one collection, modes Site, Product light, Product dark; one collection per mode on a one-mode plan) and shadows as effect styles: tokens.json plus use_figma scripts, safe to rerun.

commands.name: figma push
commands.summary: Figma-ready output: an illustration as a use_figma script of real ellipses bound to the color variables (plus SVG for upload_assets); an SVG or picture for upload_assets (small SVGs also as a createNodeFromSvg script); a component preview or page as self-contained HTML for html_to_figma.

commands.name: figma pull
commands.summary: The read steps for a Figma node (create_session, get_variable_defs, get_design_context) and where to save each result for figma check.

commands.name: figma check
commands.summary: Checks saved get_variable_defs JSON and get_design_context code against the brand tokens: colors, fonts, text sizes, radii and spacing. Off-brand values are listed with the nearest token; exits 1 when there are any.

unknownName: exits 1 and names the nearest choices
